description_en: Deletes a rule configured in a specified protection module
description_zh: 调用DeleteProtectionModuleRule删除指定防护模块中配置的规则
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-protection-module-rule --domain www.aliyundoc.com --defense-type ac_custom --rule-id 42754 --instance-id waf-cn-mp91530000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteProtectionModuleRule

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to delete the protection rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html operation to query all domain names that are added to WAF
parameters.help_zh:
要删除防护规则的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已接入WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The protection feature module to which the rule to be deleted belongs. Valid values:

waf-codec: the decoding settings of the rule protection engine

tamperproof: the web tamper-proofing rule configurations

dlp: the sensitive information leakage prevention rule configurations

ng_account: the account security rule configurations

antifraud: the data risk control protection request configurations

antifraud_js: the data risk control JavaScript insertion page configurations

bot_algorithm: the intelligent algorithm rules for bot management

bot_wxbb_pkg: the version protection rules for app protection

bot_wxbb: the path protection rules for app protection

ac_custom: the rule configurations for custom protection policies

whitelist: the whitelist rule configurations
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的防护规则所属防护功能模块。取值：

waf-codec：表示规则防护引擎解码设置。

tamperproof：表示网站防篡改规则配置。

dlp：表示防敏感信息泄漏规则配置。

ng_account：表示账户安全规则配置。

antifraud：表示数据风控防护请求配置。

antifraud_js：表示数据风控JS插入页面配置。

bot_algorithm：表示Bot管理的智能算法规则。

bot_wxbb_pkg：表示App防护的版本防护规则。

bot_wxbb：表示App防护的路径防护规则。

ac_custom：表示自定义防护策略规则配置。

whitelist：表示白名单规则配置
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection rule to be deleted.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html operation to query the IDs of all rules in a specified protection module
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的防护规则的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html查询指定防护功能模块下的所有规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. Default value: empty, which indicates the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
